description: Get the major-holding notifications regulators outside the US publish for one listing, written MIC:TICKER (e.g. XLON:BARC): who crossed a voting-rights threshold in the company (3%, 5%, 10% and up), on which date, and the resulting position. Coverage today is the UK Financial Conduct Authority's National Storage Mechanism, the TR-1 'Holding(s) in Company' notifications under DTR 5, matched to the issuer by ISIN or LEI. Each row is one notification by the person subject to the notification obligation: the percentage of the issuer's voting rights held through shares (direct and indirect) and through financial instruments, the total, and the previous notified total. These are dated notifications, not a current shareholder register, and are never summed or merged with SEC 13F, 13D or 13G data; a correction replaces the version it corrects. For a US listing, 5% holders file Schedules 13D and 13G; use GetTopHolders for 13F institutional holders.

maxResults.description: Maximum notifications, newest event first (default 20, max 100).

ticker.description: Listing symbol MIC:TICKER, e.g. XLON:BARC; a provider suffix such as BARC.L also works. A bare ticker names a US listing and is answered with the US ownership tools and the company's listings outside the US.
